The structure of K8Rb4Tl4Br24 (reduced formula K2RbTlBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Rb and Tl centers, each coordinated by six Br neighbors, while K centers show a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement of Br. Corner-sharing between Rb and Tl octahedra and face-sharing between these octahedra and the K 12-vertex polyhedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
